todo.label: To reply
todo.empty: Nothing to reply to. Fetch your mailboxes, or connect one in Connected accounts.
todo.about: New emails that wait for your answer. Reply, or mark one solved if it needs none.

none.label: Solved
none.about: Emails that no longer need a reply. Mark them solved yourself, or let a rule do it.

sent.label: Answered
sent.empty: No reply sent or saved as a draft yet.
sent.about: Emails you replied to. A reply saved as a draft counts too.

ignored.label: Archive
ignored.about: Emails not worth handling: spam, newsletters, unwanted mail. Archive them yourself, or let a rule do it.
